nodes.title: Finish sigmas from faster IO (2 Euler updates)
No extra noise after the upscale handoff
Ref2V Hybrid Native - PDD + DMD latent upscale
widgets_values:
# Ref2V: native PDD warmup + clean latent upscale + DMD joint finish

The reference image feeds all three native Ref2V encoders. Use `<Picture 1>` in the prompts.

**Stage 1:** matching native Ref2VA Acc-8Step LoRA at strength 1; video/audio shifts 12/3. Native Basic Scheduler = simple, 8 steps, denoise 1. Split at 7 and use Euler / CFG 1. SamplerCustomAdvanced exposes both noisy output and denoised output for the clean upscaler.

**Upscale:** reference 3D FP32 model, target 0.8 MP, precision fp32, temporal chunking off, keep loaded on. Change Final megapixels to set output size. Low-res dimensions remain separate.

**Stage 2:** reference taomate FL2VA 3-step DMD LoRA at 0.8, applied only to the joint branch. Euler / CFG 1, Disable Noise, sigmas `0.631578922, 0.3158, 0.0000`: three sigma points mean **two** finishing updates, so 7 + 2 = 9 total steps. The unused final native PDD interval is replaced.

**Timeline:** three 243-frame windows, 39-frame overlap = 651 frames at 24 fps. If adding prompts, update the window count (3) in the timeline expression and connect the added conditioning to Hybrid Windows. Queue the whole graph together; the upscaler needs the warmup state.

Recipe: V2V Upscale PDD+Lightx - faster IO. Uses native ComfyUI sampler nodes, ComfyUI-HybridWindows and Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler.
